title: ACID vs BASE
subtitle: Some data needs all-or-nothing, and some can wait to agree
motto: Match the guarantee to the data
keyInsight: A transaction prevents lost money at a cost in throughput, so spend it on data that cannot be repeated and skip it for data that can lag.

decisions.title: Measure lost dollars, not just crashes
decisions.description: The failure frame reports money lost so the cost of skipping a transaction is a number a learner can feel.
decisions.alternatives: Counting failed transfers would hide the fact that some failures are invisible, since the system does not know the money is gone.

decisions.title: Use a like counter as the BASE example
decisions.description: A like count is data everyone agrees can be late, so the frame shows BASE being the right call instead of a compromise.
decisions.alternatives: Using a payment for BASE would suggest eventual consistency is a downgrade rather than a fit for the right data.
